## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

Just a demo!

```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

How many peguins in the dataset for each species

```{r}

bill_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(mean_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))

bill_summary
```

```{r}

ggplot(bill_summary, aes(x = species, y = mean_bill_length, fill = species)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Mean bill length",
       title = "Average Bill Length by Species")


```
